title: Tabletop Match Ledger
user: Tabletop groups playing multi-round games with wraparound boards or cumulative scoring who need a shared, reliable match state between rounds.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA with a five-second setup, configurable players, round and score tracks, lap counters, target scoring, undo history, and a shareable final receipt.
constraints: Local-first, no copyrighted game assets or rules text, user-configurable scoring.
